description: Change a sync's name, query, mapping, cursor, schedule, lists or options, or pause/resume it with `isEnabled`. A changed query or cursor reads from the beginning again; unchanged rows are still skipped.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

cursorColumn.description: Column read incrementally, for example updated_at. Each run reads rows at or after the last value. Empty string clears it on update.

listIds.description: Subscriber syncs only: lists that contacts the sync creates join. Existing contacts keep their lists.

mapping.description: Column mapping. Subscriber syncs: emailColumn (or phoneColumn), externalIdColumn?, firstNameColumn?, lastNameColumn?, tagsColumn?, attributes?: [{"column","attribute"}]. Event syncs: emailColumn or externalIdColumn, eventNameColumn or eventName (fixed), eventIdColumn?, occurredAtColumn?, properties?: [{"column","property"}]. Columns must exist in the query; run `preview_warehouse_query` first.

optInMode.description: Subscriber syncs only. confirmed (default) imports contacts whose consent is already verified; double_opt_in emails new contacts first and needs automations:trigger.

triggerAutomations.description: Let new contacts or events from the last hour start automations. Default false. Needs automations:trigger.

name: update_warehouse_sync

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_warehouse_sync` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sync.description: The warehouse sync record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
